Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 12

“Then Bhishma, the powerful grandsire of the Kurus, the eldest of the dynasty, roared like a lion and blew his conch shell loudly, cheering Duryodhana.”

The first sound of the war — Bhishma's conch, meant to fill Duryodhana with confidence. A moment of theatre before the real fighting starts.
